انتهكتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَهَكْتُنَّ (intahaktunna) /in.ta.hak.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اُنْتُهِكْتُنَّ (untuhiktunna) /un.tu.hik.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
